decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - 11.2	The application for the erection of a rear dormer to rear elevation to house and side dormer to side elevation of house, as shown on drawing numbers LR5029-01 and LR5029-06 Revision A received 16 September 2005, and LR5029-02 Revision B and LR5029-04 Revision B received 7 November 2005 (Amended plans), is recommended for approval as the proposed development would not harm the appearance or character of the area or unduly reduce the existing amenity of neighbouring properties. Therefore the proposed development satisfactorily complies with the relevant London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 policies; ENV-B.1.1 New Development and H.6.4 Extensions and Alterations.
description: Erection of single storey side extension, erection of part two storey rear addition and erection of roof extension with rear dormer to rear elevation to house and side dormer to side elevation of house.
